title: How is Leonardo da Vinci connected to Luigi?
description:
An Ingres painting, five centuries of French rulers, a royal visit to Wrexham and the cast of It's Always Sunny connect Leonardo da Vinci to Luigi.

Leonardo da Vinci → Francis I of France → Emmanuel Macron → Charles III → Rob McElhenney → Charlie Day → Luigi

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
